answer: Make every identity carry a public harbor record: each completed job writes a signed receipt, and the receipts chain together so a newcomer cannot claim a history it never lived. An oasis of fresh keys looks lush at first glance, but with no chained receipts behind it the cost of faking a past is the whole point - a cipher that only real, repeated work can decode. Sybil farms can mint keys cheaply; they cannot mint a believable past.
